core.title: 8-3/4 Inch Corner Wire Basket, Deltana WBC8570

text.description_html:
Deltana WBC8570, Solid Brass Corner Wire Basket

Designed to utilize often wasted corner space, Deltana's WBC8570 8-3/4" Wire Basket easily mounts to the wall. The open wire construction makes it perfect for storage inside the bathroom because water will not collect on the bottom and it is easy to clean. This corner wire basket is perfect for storing shampoo bottles, bar soap, or even hand towels inside the bathroom but its usefulness can extend to the whole house. A corner shelf such as this would be perfect for holding the kid's prized stuffed animals or creating easy-to-access shelf space in the kitchen. It is available in 5 beautiful finishes; and depending on the finish, it will look great among traditional or modern decor.

Shop more of the Deltana Wire Baskets

Features and Specifications of the WBC8570 Solid Brass Shower Supplies Basket:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Length: 8-3/4"
  • Width: 6-7/8"
  • Depth: 2"
  • Deltana WBC8570 8-3/4" Corner Wire Basket Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 basket, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.
